mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies and 53 degrees near Verona City Hall. Under a waxing crescent moon, keep an eye on the sky at 5:43 PM for a space station flyover moving from the south over Belleville toward the east.

Important updates include the availability of 2027 municipal candidate packets at the City Clerk office and continued progress on the Military Ridge State Trail paving project, which has a public meeting set for December 8.

Today is packed with local options including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, while tomorrow offers trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
In a notable service call from October 25, officers responded to an intersection where they performed an O W I arrest after finding a driver unresponsive.
Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Caramel Twist and you can stop by any time until the store closes at 10:00 PM.
